joes_addons_for_abmc.config.sound.bell_t: Whether the Bell staff plays a tinnitus (ear ringing) sound when rung. When disabled, ringing still silences other sounds (the sound-dampening effect remains), but no ear-ringing sound plays.
joes_addons_for_abmc.config.sound.redsto: Whether the Redstone Block staff plays laser sound effects (start / looping / end) when firing. When disabled, the laser beam still renders but makes no sound.
joes_addons_for_abmc.config.sound.comman: Whether the Command Block staff plays a flight sound while the player is flying with it.
joes_addons_for_abmc.config.line_converg: Horizontal (right) offset in blocks of the line emitter / converge point relative to the staff holder. Applies to all staffs that emit a line or converge particles: redstone laser, cobweb beam, enchant link, command feedback line, Omega absorb. The offset is relative to the holder's head direction (visual angle, including look-up/down pitch), so the position moves relatively when the holder looks up or down. Range -10 to 10.
Vertical (up) offset in blocks of the line emitter / converge point relative to the staff holder. Relative to the holder's head direction; moves relatively when looking up or down. Range -10 to 10.
Forward (front) offset in blocks of the line emitter / converge point relative to the staff holder. Relative to the holder's head direction; moves relatively when looking up or down. Range -10 to 10.

Extra X (right) offset in blocks applied on top of the converge offset only in third person or when another holder uses the staff, to fine-tune the position difference (e.g. height) of the staff between first and third person views. Also relative to the holder's head direction; moves relatively when looking up or down. Range -10 to 10.

Extra Y (up) offset in blocks applied only in third person or when another holder uses the staff. Also relative to the holder's head direction; moves relatively when looking up or down. Range -10 to 10.

Extra Z (forward) offset in blocks applied only in third person or when another holder uses the staff. Also relative to the holder's head direction; moves relatively when looking up or down. Range -10 to 10.
joes_addons_for_abmc.config.chain.chain_: Vertical lift strength of the Chain (Iron Block) staff: how far a grabbed creature is raised when the player looks straight up (and lowered when looking down). 0 disables the lift effect. Range 0 to 10.
joes_addons_for_abmc.config.start.give_s: Whether to give the player a staff (with empty block type) when they first enter the world. Only granted once per player; when disabled, never granted.
patchouli.joes_addons_for_abmc.guide.lan: Welcome to the Joe's Addons for ABMC guide!$(br2)This mod aims to recreate all the Minecraft mechanics from the AVM universe.$(br2)In Survival, chapters unlock as you progress; in Creative/Spectator everything is readable.
patchouli.joes_addons_for_abmc.cat.getti: What this mod is, and how to get your first staff.
patchouli.joes_addons_for_abmc.cat.staff: Detailed explanations for every block staff. Unlocks once you obtain any staff.
patchouli.joes_addons_for_abmc.cat.potio: Awakening, transmutation, antidote and teleportation potions.
patchouli.joes_addons_for_abmc.entry.tra: The $(bold)Transmutation potion$() (splash) transforms a creature it hits into a $(bold)block$() or an $(bold)item$(): blocks solidify in place at a suitable spot, items become drops.$(br2)The random variant ("Transmute to §krandom") picks a target from all registered blocks/items at the moment of impact — never creatures or players; fluids, air, invisible/technical blocks and dependant blocks are excluded.

A creature turned into a block/item can be restored early with the $(bold)Transmutation Antidote$().$(br2)The creative tab also offers fixed-target variants (e.g. bone, blackstone, husk shell, player shell) that always transmute into the specified target — no randomness.

$(bold)Brewing$():$(br2)① Water Bottle + Soul Sand → Haunted Potion$(br)② Haunted Potion + Nether Wart → Transmutation Base (Awkward Potion + Soul Sand also works)$(br)③ Base + any item/block → a "Transmute to XX" potion (fixed target)$(br2)$(bold)Special targets$(): Base + a renamed Name Tag → the $(bold)player shell$() of that name; Base + a Spawn Egg → that $(bold)mob$().$(br2)$(bold)Enhancements$(): Transmutation potion + Redstone → longer duration; + Gunpowder → splash; splash + Dragon's Breath → lingering.
patchouli.joes_addons_for_abmc.entry.wha: Joe's Addons for ABMC ultimately aims to recreate all the Minecraft mechanics from the AVM (Animation vs. Minecraft) universe — the $(bold)Staff$() is one of its core gameplay features, but far from all.$(br2)A single $(bold)staff$() item turns into completely different tools depending on the attached block type (BLOCKTYPE). Beyond staves, the mod adds potions (Awakening, Transmutation, Teleportation), the Witch Boss and several powerful weapons.

This book currently focuses on the staff and will grow along with the mod:$(br)• "Getting Started" — where staves come from and how variants work;$(br)• "Staff Lexicon" — unlocked after obtaining any staff, explaining every block staff in detail.
patchouli.joes_addons_for_abmc.entry.sta: In Survival, there are three main ways to obtain a staff:$(br2)$(bold)1. Starting gift$(): set $(italic)give_staff_on_start$() to $(bold)true$() in the mod config (off by default) to receive a blank staff when first entering the world.

$(bold)2. All-achievements reward$(): after unlocking every vanilla achievement, a blank staff is granted automatically (once per player).$(br2)$(bold)3. Creative mode$(): all 37 block staff variants are available in the "Joe's Addons for ABMC" creative tab.
$(bold)Note$(): a blank staff (empty) has no special ability by itself — it only takes effect after a block type is attached. See "Staff Variants" for details.

The staff is one item, but through the BLOCKTYPE data component it can become 37 entirely different "block staves" — e.g. the Note Block staff, Redstone Block staff, Brewing Stand staff...$(br2)Each variant has its own icon, attributes and right-click ability — effectively 37 separate tools.

$(bold)Load & switch$(): hold a block in your other hand (e.g. staff in the main hand, gold block in the off hand) and press the $(bold)middle mouse button$() to load that block onto the staff, turning it into the matching block staff (consuming 1 of that block). Swapping the hands (staff in the off hand, block in the main hand) works the same way.$(br2)Middle-clicking with a different block $(bold)switches$() the form (the previous block is returned as an item, and the two blocks keep their block durability independently); middle-clicking with an empty hand $(bold)unloads$() the block, restoring the blank staff.$(br2)$(bold)Exceptions$(): the Him staff cannot be loaded/switched from blocks (middle-click with an empty hand triggers its special dismantle), and the Omega staff can never be dismantled or switched.
patchouli.joes_addons_for_abmc.entry.not: The Note Block staff has two modes, switched with $(bold)Alt + Scroll$():$(br2)$(bold)Note mode$(): hold right-click to launch a random-colored note particle every 2 ticks; it flies in a straight line for 2 seconds and deals 4 damage to creatures it hits (ignoring invulnerability frames). Notes cannot pass through walls (transparent blocks excepted).

$(bold)Staff-sheet mode$(): left-click to place a 5-line staff sheet (white particles, lasts 4 seconds) in front of you; creatures overlapping it are hard-stunned. Right-click fires a note along each line with random sounds (5-tick cooldown) and resets the sheet timer.

$(bold)Off-hand instrument$(): holding a block item in the off hand changes the instrument following vanilla note block rules:$(br)• Stone / cobblestone and similar — bass drum$(br)• Wood (logs / planks) — bass; sand / gravel — snare; glass — hat$(br)• Gold block — flute; bone block — bell; emerald block — pling$(br)• Iron block — iron xylophone; soul sand — cow bell; hay bale — banjo$(br2)Holding a mob head plays that mob's sound (pitch fixed, not tunable); other blocks keep a random note pitch.
patchouli.joes_addons_for_abmc.entry.red: Hold right-click to fire a redstone ray along your sight line: it damages creatures (small AOE), strongly powers and drives redstone machines, and breaks blocks.
Scroll to adjust the charge level (1–8): higher charge means more damage and stronger effects, but faster durability drain (at charge 8 it deals damage every tick and keeps blocks powered).
patchouli.joes_addons_for_abmc.entry.bre: The Brewing Stand staff throws potions and potion clouds: $(bold)left-click$() toggles between bottle/cloud form, $(bold)Alt + Scroll$() cycles buff/debuff/transmutation category. The HUD shows both rows.

Buff/debuff categories throw the corresponding vanilla potions (e.g. Strength, Swiftness / Poison, Weakness); the transmutation category throws random block/item transmutation potions. Each throw costs 1 durability.
patchouli.joes_addons_for_abmc.entry.her: The Him staff has melee and ranged modes (shown in the HUD). $(bold)Melee mode$(): grants strong melee attributes while held; $(bold)ranged mode$(): hold right-click to continuously fire Herobrine heads toward where you look, dealing heavy damage.
The heads deal area damage and make this one of the mod's most threatening staves; mind your aim and distance to avoid friendly fire.
patchouli.joes_addons_for_abmc.entry.ome: The Omega staff's $(bold)absorb mode$(): hold right-click to pull the targeted creature toward you (tilt your head up/down to adjust), then release to restore its movement and enter a short cooldown.
While holding the Omega staff or the Omega Game Icon, you gain flight, night vision and immunity to all damage except the void.
patchouli.joes_addons_for_abmc.entry.obs: Right-click to pull up a small ellipsoid cluster of blocks in front of you and launch them forward; the thrown blocks instantly solidify in place when hitting a block (no drops).
Same kind of ability as the Bedrock staff, but with a much smaller selection area — good for precise moves of a few blocks.
patchouli.joes_addons_for_abmc.entry.ice: Right-click a creature to freeze it: blocks touching its hitbox become frosted ice, and the creature gets Mining Fatigue and is pinned — it cannot move or jump (even flying creatures are held in place).$(br2)Natural melting of the ice deals no damage. Only when the frosted ice is $(bold)broken early$() (mined) and the broken count exceeds half of the blocks placed in that freeze, the trapped creature takes a shatter: if its health is above 15 it loses half (reducible by armor/resistance), otherwise it is killed outright.
The aim range is about 3× the normal entity interaction range — great for locking down targets first. To deal the shatter damage, mine more than half of the ice while the target is trapped.
patchouli.joes_addons_for_abmc.entry.gol: $(bold)Melee$(): the Gold Block staff is a solid melee tool — $(bold)+20$() attack damage (with a slower attack speed), a slight knockback on hit, and $(bold)+2.5$() blocks of block/entity interaction range.$(br2)$(bold)Area mining$(): breaking a block with it also breaks a 3 wide × 3 high × 2 deep area in the direction you face (each level of Strength increases every side by 1). Great for mining and fast digging.
Note that area mining consumes block durability. Compared to the Diamond Block staff (5×5×4), gold has a smaller, more precise area and costs less durability.
patchouli.joes_addons_for_abmc.entry.net: $(bold)Attributes$(): up to $(bold)+300$() attack damage (with an extremely slow attack speed), +2.5 interaction range and +0.9 knockback resistance, at the cost of reduced movement speed.$(br2)$(bold)Massive area mining$(): breaking a block also destroys the blocks inside a $(bold)9×9×9$() cube anchored at that block (each level of Strength adds +2 to every side), except unbreakable blocks like bedrock — the ultimate terraforming tool.
Area mining consumes block durability per block actually broken. The range is huge — mind your feet and what is behind you before swinging.
patchouli.joes_addons_for_abmc.entry.bel: $(bold)Melee$(): +3.5 attack damage with a slower attack speed, plus +2.5 interaction range.$(br2)$(bold)Bell strike$(): hitting a creature rings the bell and launches it forcefully along your facing direction (horizontal knockback plus an upward toss); each target can only be triggered once every 20 seconds.

$(bold)Debuffs$(): the struck creature suffers Darkness, Blindness, Slowness, Mining Fatigue, Weakness and Nausea for about 15 seconds. If the target is a player, they also get $(bold)ear ringing$() and lose all sound for about 20 seconds (the ringing tone can be disabled in config, but the silence effect remains).
patchouli.joes_addons_for_abmc.entry.anv: $(bold)Anvil experience$(): while held, $(bold)movement and jumping are completely disabled$() (movement speed and jump strength are zeroed) and gravity is heavier — truly "carrying an anvil".$(br2)It has no active ability and no attack damage bonus; it is purely a weight-themed staff.
Its only upsides are +2.5 interaction range and a slower attack speed. One of the mod's rare "negative experience" staves — use with caution.
patchouli.joes_addons_for_abmc.entry.bed: Right-click to pull up a large cluster of blocks and launch them forward; the thrown blocks solidify in place when hitting a block.
Its selection area is far larger than the Obsidian staff, ideal for moving big terrain; double-check the selection before use to avoid grabbing too much.
